title: WACC intuition

sourceRefs.section: DCF — WACC and Cost of Equity
Discounted Cash Flow — Cost of Capital

objectives: Answer out loud: Walk me through WACC.
Answer out loud: Why after-tax cost of debt?
Answer out loud: Why market weights?

steps.body: WACC = the blended required return of everyone who funds the company.
It's the discount rate for *unlevered* FCF, because UFCF is available to all investors.
Weights use market values and ideally the company's target capital structure.

legend.meaning: Market values of equity, debt and preferred

blocks.title: Why is cost of debt after-tax but cost of equity isn't?
blocks.teaser: Interest is tax-deductible, so the government effectively subsidizes part of it.
blocks.body:
Interest is tax-deductible, so the government effectively subsidizes part of it. Dividends to shareholders aren't deductible.

**Interview answer:** "Interest is tax-deductible, so debt's true cost is lower after tax. Dividends aren't deductible, so equity gets no adjustment."

blocks.prompt: Why is the cost of debt tax-effected in WACC but the cost of equity isn't?

options.text: Equity holders pay taxes on dividends
Debt is valued at book, equity at market

blocks.explanation: Interest lowers taxable income, so the government effectively subsidizes part of it. Dividends get no such deduction.

blocks.title: Why market values instead of book?
blocks.teaser: WACC is the return investors require today on what their capital is worth today.
blocks.body: WACC is the return investors require today on what their capital is worth today. Book equity reflects historical accounting and can even be negative.

blocks.title: Current or target capital structure?
blocks.teaser: Target, because the DCF projects the long-term future.
blocks.body: Target, because the DCF projects the long-term future. A company that's temporarily over-levered after an acquisition will likely delever.

blocks.title: Why does WACC match UFCF but cost of equity match levered FCF?
blocks.teaser: Match cash flows to the investors who receive them.
blocks.body: Match cash flows to the investors who receive them. UFCF goes to all investors → WACC. Levered FCF (after interest and debt payments) goes only to equity → cost of equity.

blocks.title: What's the WACC of a company with no debt?
blocks.teaser: It equals the cost of equity.
blocks.body: It equals the cost of equity.
